figurative_meaning_bn: অন্নবস্ত্রের সংস্থান; গ্রাসাচ্ছাদন; থাকা-খাওয়া; ভাত-কাপড়; ভরণপোষণব্যয়
figurative_meaning_en: Provision of food and clothing; sustenance; board and lodging; maintenance expenses
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার খোরপোশের ব্যবস্থা করা খুব কঠিন হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Arranging his upkeep has become very difficult.
The responsibility of the family's sustenance lies on him.
note: The idiom reflects traditional concerns with basic survival needs in Bengali society.
